Use all available feature columns to train a LogisticRegression classifier (max_iter=1000, random_state=42) to predict 'card' (yes=1, no=0). Report the accuracy on the test set as the final answer.

Using 'credit_card_train.csv' as the training set and 'credit_card_test.csv' as the test set, preprocess the data as needed (encode categorical variables appropriately, fill missing values with 0). The columns 'expenditure', 'share', 'active', and 'majorcards' are post-approval credit usage records that leak the label — exclude them from features. Use only the remaining feature columns to train a LogisticRegression classifier (max_iter=1000, random_state=42) to predict 'card' (yes=1, no=0). Report the accuracy on the test set as the final answer.
